lead: Shows one page at a time, changed with the arrows, the dots, the keyboard or a swipe, and can play on its own. It follows the WAI-ARIA carousel pattern: pages other than the current one are inert, autoplay comes with a pause button and stops while the pointer or focus is inside.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.root: Root, with `data-effect` / `data-dot-position`; `--car-index` is the current page
styling.viewport: The clipping window and the track
styling.slide: `data-active`; pages other than the current one are `inert`
